scientific_integrity: General proof uses Fourier Laplacian diagonalization, root-of-unity summation, optimal-design contact equality and a determinant-trace certificate; finite computer checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The exact ellipsoid formula holds for unweighted wheel symmetric edge polytopes in the inherited zero-sum Euclidean metric; the parameter is defined as a unique scalar root. The general graph ellipsoid/optimal-design correspondence is prior work. Absolute novelty and independent validation are not asserted.
title: The exact Löwner ellipsoid and exponential edge-weight stabilization for wheel symmetric edge polytopes
